'''WG-22''', styled as '''Gonk Gladiator''',<ref name="Smuggler's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]''</ref> was a modified [[EG-series power droid|EG-series]] [[power droid]]<ref name="Official Guide" /><ref name="Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition" /> made by [[Ralakili]] to be a [[gladiator droid]] to fight in his [[droid]] [[fighting pit]]s inside [[Fort Ypso]] on [[Vandor]]. The droid's mechanical [[limb]]s could puncture metal with devastating might powered by electricity produced in his interior [[power cell]]s.<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|wg-22|WG-22}}</ref> In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Official Guide" /> his fight<ref name="Solo" /> with [[FD3-MN]]<ref name="Official Guide" /> was interrupted by the protests of [[L3-37]] for [[droid rights]], which cost WG-22 dearly.<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
The droid was one of several characters in the film portrayed by ''[[Star Wars]]'' veteran [[Warwick Davis]].<ref name="WG-22">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cinemablend.com/news/2457730/warwick-davis-actually-played-a-lot-more-roles-in-solo-than-we-realized|text=Warwick Davis Actually Played A Lot More Roles In Solo Than We Realized|author=Libbey, Dirk|date=2018-09-18|archivedate=20200528234840}}</ref>
